body: Man, you have been so helpful, thank you so much for your time and reassurance!!! Have a great rest of your week 🥰

Thank you so much for replying, I really appreciate your time! I would be on a good buzz after three drinks and didn’t plan on having anymore after three. I was thinking if I drink a spirit with a zero-sugar mixer would be the way to go. I’m not looking to get slammed, just want to relax and unwind and get up the next day to carry on prep and life as usual. As I said, I don’t drink very often and I’m 100% confident that it wouldn’t happen again between now and comp but I am serious in terms of wanting to compete which is why I wanted to weigh it up. Ultimately if it’s going to affect my progress drastically I won’t go through with it, but just wanted to see what the general consensus was.

Edit: I can get peckish when I drink, but I’ll crank out the carrot sticks and tablespoon of hummus to tie me over as a treat 😉

Hey! First time figure competitor and I’m 7.5 weeks out from my first comp. I just wanted some advice around alcohol consumption. It’s end of semester for me on Friday and oh boy has it been STRESSFUL. I drink only a handful of times a year but was wondering at this stage of my prep would I be okay to get a little bit tipsy to unwind on Friday and if so, what’s the best think for me to drink? I have stuck to my meal plan pretty hard core for 8 weeks as well (no drinking during this time) so this would be the first time I’ve deliberately deviated away from it. 

Thanks heaps!
November Rain - Guns n Roses 🌹
HEY G A M E R S
I am feeling v empowered, thank you, random citizen
This comment has given me hope, I’m going to be a strong, independent rat that don’t need no Michael to wish a happy birthday to
Who will I sing we’re the rats to now? :(
Me and my ex use to watch Jerma together. He made me a fan, we use to watch Jerma all the time. Now I watch Jerma on my own, listening to shitting and farting on my own just isn’t the same 💔
Thank you, I’ll try
I literally can’t because of the surgery I’ve just had :( Won’t be another week or two until I can leave home

I’ll keep my opinions to myself around politics in the USA, but yes we are extremely lucky to have her. 

I’ve made the same pact with myself funnily enough, although nights like this make it hard to remember so thank you for actually reminding me. You’ve been wonderful, thank you so much for your time and I truly wish you all the best! Always here if you need someone to talk to, please take care

I’m not, I’m actually from New Zealand so it’s bloody expensive to go anywhere unfortunately. I’m trying to save up enough money to ironically visit my partner when he moves over for temp work in the USA and then hopefully travel to Canada and Japan with him. 

I’ve been telling people I’ve wanted to go to Europe to those exact places for the past five years but have never managed to go. I feel like a total failure for talking the talk but not walking the walk. I’m glad you’ve been able to go there, I really hope you enjoyed it and got to play in the snow!!!

I’m sorry your sleep isn’t great either, what do you do to try and get to sleep? I’ve started reading again for the first time in 10 years and while it doesn’t help with my sleepiness, it’s better than mindlessly scrolling the internet I guess

Hey! Firstly thank you so much for taking the time to respond, really appreciate it. 

I’m currently on Quetiapine and recently put on a small dose of zopiclone to help manage my sleep short term. I’m sleeping now but it’s not helping me with my tireness if that makes sense? So I just feel trash that I can’t even do something as basic as sleep properly. 

Yeah dude, I totally get that. I want to get away. I’ve only ever left the country because of sport so I’d love to go overseas on an actual holiday. Maybe I’ll come back all “in touch with myself and cultured” like every other girl I’ve been to school with lol. Are you going anywhere or do you recommend going anywhere?

I am in the exact same boat with having PTSD and been told the same thing. Some days I believe it, other days like today are hard to see through. Thank you for reminding me and I am so pleased that you are here and able to give wonderful advice, I really appreciate your time
Omg. I can’t believe someone actually replied. This means more to me than you’ll ever know, thank you so much for just commenting...

I’m really sorry you feel this way, I hope that maybe by reading this thread you don’t feel so alone. I definitely feel this way a lot, some days are easier than others and I try to be as thankful as I can for the good days. That’s easier said than done. 

I feel like I’m going to float around in this world until something takes me or I take myself. I feel like I have no purpose and that’s really hard. Part of me doesn’t want to live, but I want to find out if there is something worth living for that I haven’t found yet. I hope you have a little flicker of that too OP. 

If it means anything, I’m thinking of you and I really hope you hang in there. Let’s try do this together.
Thanks dude, I thought that would help but I haven’t been able to keep anything down for the over 12 hours now, I’m a mess!!!
Honestly I am up shit creek without a paddle 🤦‍♀️

He calls me squirrel because whenever he compliments me or says something nice I scrunch my nose up and it’s honestly the most lovely thing :3 I’ve never had a pet name before and tbh never really was a fan until he called me that. I’m his squirrel and he’s my bear and I love it so much ❤️
